changes.result: execution_targets.music_input contains current-project-shared scope, selected_source, timeline_source, range and requires_revalidation. Sources whitelist audio_version/duration_seconds/metadata_status/rights_status/blocked; raw metadata/path/bytes/filename/rights prose are excluded. Missing/invalid duration is unavailable; finite values are bounded to the exact JSON integer range. Range remains tied to its own explicit source=user/audio version, with selected/timeline match flags.

A server-created music_context marker identifies persisted run/call, exact history location/tool_use_id and digest. New trusted lookups supersede the marker; other tools carry it forward. Approval and _current compare receipt projection, disclosed projection and current projection. Stale followup is blocked with a requery/new-consent message, without editing the approved body or adding an automatic retry.

execution_targets.music_input.timeline_source: null or same whitelist; can refer to a different saved source

response_contract.latest_authority_rule: Only the most recent successful server search_project_context receipt designated by this preview marker is authoritative. Historical messages are not scanned for JSON. A newer trusted lookup replaces the marker; other tools retain it. An obsolete followup must be rejected and queried again in a fresh prompt-only turn for new exact-manifest consent.
